faq.headline: What you need to know before your surgical decision.

faq-1.question: How does the private care flow work?
faq-1.answer: Care at Hospital São Rafael is exclusively private and follows an integrated flow, from the first contact to discharge. It all begins with scheduling through our care center, which organizes each step according to your needs: appointments, exams, check-ups, and surgical preparation. Next, you have appointments and exams at the IMD, the Medical and Diagnostic Institute, where information is already entered digitally into the integrated medical record. Once preparation is complete, including the pre-anesthetic consultation when indicated, the procedure is performed in one of our 22 operating rooms. After surgery, you go through recovery with continuous support from the team, and can count on the Transition Unit until a safe return to your routine. This entire journey takes place without leaving our complex.

faq-2.question: Can my surgeon operate at São Rafael?
faq-2.answer: Yes. Hospital São Rafael is an open medical staff hospital, which means any physician with an active registration in good standing with the board may request accreditation to perform procedures at our facilities, without an employment relationship with the hospital. The process is conducted by our Physician Relations team, which reviews the professional's profile and aligns the applicable specialties and protocols. Once accredited, the surgeon has access to 22 operating rooms equipped with state-of-the-art technology, a dedicated nursing team, technical support, and an interval between surgeries planned for greater agility and efficiency. To start the process, get in touch through the "Talk to Physician Relations" button.

faq-3.question: What is the real difference of the Accommodation Upgrade?
faq-3.answer: The Accommodation Upgrade moves you to a luxury suite, with a private bathroom and more privacy and comfort during recovery. In addition to all the clinical support, you have exclusive, personalized service and an environment designed for you to rest peacefully. We have 30 luxury suites and 26 standard beds, and the team will advise on availability at scheduling.

faq-4.question: How does IMD speed up my surgery?
faq-4.answer: The IMD works in an integrated way with Hospital São Rafael's surgical center. Appointments, imaging exams, and reports performed at the Institute, with reports within 24h, feed the surgical center's digital medical record, with no rerouting, no repetition of information, and no data loss. When the day of surgery arrives, your physician already has access to everything needed, with full traceability. This model reduces the wait and the bureaucracy between diagnosis and procedure, with more agility, safety, and predictability for you and your surgeon.
